proposal.hypothesis: The adapter preserves tool-call IDs, result linkage, roles, and parsed nested arguments for the supplied assistant/tool sequence; empty assistant content with tool calls normalizes to null, which is not a regression. Unknown content types or semantic extensions would be INCONCLUSIVE, and an invalid baseline would be NEEDS_REVIEW.

repair_proposals: Preserve tool_call IDs and tool_call_id linkage verbatim when converting assistant and tool messages; do not renumber or drop IDs.
Keep parsed nested tool-call arguments intact (including numeric vs boolean distinctions) rather than re-serializing with type coercion.
Treat empty assistant content with tool calls as null only when tool calls are present, and keep empty tool result content as an empty string.
For unknown content block types or semantic extensions, return INCONCLUSIVE rather than asserting equivalence.
Validate baseline message sequences (every tool call has a matching tool result) and return NEEDS_REVIEW when the baseline is invalid.
